# Quaternius

Creator: Quaternius — https://quaternius.com
Packs: Ultimate Modular Men (February 2022), Cyberpunk Game Kit (July 2022).
Original CC0 1.0 License.txt files are retained under each pack folder.

Selected FBX characters, rigged sword/pistol, and a small environment subset were imported from user-provided ZIP archives.
Generated prefabs, Animator Controllers, lighting and scene composition belong to the project integration; the original model files remain separate.
